data.text: I support a shared limit, Emma, but I’d suggest 17 tons each rather than 18. That leaves 15, so next month starts at either 100 or 30 instead of 100 or 20—a useful buffer for only one ton less income apiece now. We should agree on stock-dependent quotas before each round, rotate any extra whole tons fairly, and discuss any overrun once catches are revealed. John, would you support 17 each this month?
